description: Points arrêt routiers du réseau Rémi - CC VAL2C is a dataset listed in Val-de-Cher-Controis open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Centre-Val de Loire. Ce jeu de données concerne l'ensemble des points d'arrêt routiers desservis par le réseau de transport routier régional (réseau scolaire et commercial) sur le territoire de la Communauté de communes Val de Cher Controis. Ces données contiennent des éléments relatifs à l'accessibilité et la signalisation des points d'arrêt routiers.Les données présentées sont indicatives. Coverage: Val-de-Cher-Controis (Loir-et-Cher). The portal files it under Mobilité, geospatial. Its keywords are mobilité, Rémi, transport, ramassage scolaire, interurbain, lignes régulières. The portal shows 15,126 records. The portal shows 2025-01-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-val2c-fr-portal.
